about: What no build graph shows: folder lines that narrow a reached test project to named classes where the coverage map has not seen the changed file (since 2026-11-02; before, always), recordings' owners, and files that are nobody's input. Every line has a dated reason. A select entry is a WiseMan filter term (FullyQualifiedName~term), cargo:<crate folder>, refs:<pathspec> (the test files naming a type declared there) or lunap. See EmuSen_Testing.md §4.2.

a project file changes what the tool assemblies' leaf test checks (EmuSen_Testing.md §3.2, rule always)
the libretro crates reach WiseMan through RustCores.props, and LibretroHostTests is the class that loads them (replay of 60 merges beside blast.sh)

the serenity crate's C surface is emusen_serenity_* and emusen_crystal_picture_* (Platform/platform/src/serenity.rs, serenity_device.rs), named in C# only by SerenityNative.cs, PlatformRing.cs and PlatformLend.cs (git grep, 2026-11-02; WiseMan's PlatformLend.cs went on 2026-11-06, its test reaching the lend through the frontend API); the classes the coverage map saw execute those files drive the chain, the ring and the device picture. Written for padloss-hang (8b9c2c4c1), a Rust-only change to the ring that coverlet cannot see

the broker's C surface is emusen_core_*, named in C# only by EmuSen/Cores/Native/CoreInterface.cs and CoreLibrary.cs (git grep, 2026-11-02); the classes the coverage map saw execute them load or run a hosted core. Written for padloss-hang (8b9c2c4c1)
